rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a close friend.

example.english: That crony often joins me for tea.
example.traditional: 嗰個老友成日陪我飲茶。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 lou5 jau5 seng4 jat6 pui4 ngo5 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this for a trusted partner who belongs to the same criminal group or gang.

example.english: The police finally arrested his crony.
example.traditional: 警方終於捉到佢個同黨。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zung1 jyu1 zuk1 dou3 keoi5 go3 tung4 dong2
